title: Bar Drop Sweet Blackcurrant 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Sweet Blackcurrant by Drop is a rich, dark berry flavour dedicated to simplicity and depth. It offers the intense, juicy taste of ripe blackcurrants, reminiscent of a classic fruit cordial. The profile is bold and jammy, providing a consistent and satisfying sweetness throughout the vape. This e-liquid features a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, which ensures the deep purple berry notes are preserved without being muted by excess thickener. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) kits, the nicotine salt blend delivers a smooth, satisfying hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
